[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] (possibly) |role = |TV actor = }} The '''spectators'''{{Ref|(Note)}} are a group of [[Fallout TV series#Cast and characters|characters]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Beginning]]=== Apparently associated with the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]], these people are seen observing the pre-[[Great War|War]] landmark meeting between Vault-Tec executives [[Barb Howard]] and [[Bud Askins]] along with other prominent corporate leaders, such as [[Robert House]], [[Frederick Sinclair]], [[Julia Masters]], and [[Leon Von Felden]], from a dark balcony above. Behind the spectators, [[man in shadows|another man]] stands alone in shadows in an observation room.''At the meeting, Barb checks her Pip-Boy. She looks up towards spectators watching from a dark balcony. Behind them, a man stands in shadows in an observation room.''
("[[The Beginning]]" audio description) ==Notes== {{Note|(Note)}} The characters' names and role are never stated in the show's [[Fallout TV series season 1|first season]]. The title of this page is based on the episode's audio description. ==Appearances== The unnamed spectators appear only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|8=108}} ==Behind the scenes== The characters are portrayed by uncredited extras. ==Gallery== File:FOTV spectators 2.png|Spectators observing the meeting ==References== {{references}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Vault-Tec characters]]
